title: Expiry and Reactivation of Dental and Vision Savings Memberships
content:
# Expiry and Reactivation

**Rule.** For the Dental and Vision Savings Memberships, a failed renewal or monthly charge is retried for 15 calendar days; when it is still unpaid the membership expires at the end of the last paid period. An expired membership may be reactivated within 60 calendar days after expiry by paying the fee due, with the reactivation fee of 0.00; later, a new membership must be purchased.

These figures are the same on all six memberships: Cascade Smile Savings Individual and Household, Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Individual and Household, and Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual and Household.

## Expiry

- An active membership expires automatically when a renewal or monthly fee remains unpaid past the 15 calendar days of retries.
- The expired membership's recorded end date is the last day of the last paid period.

## Reactivation window

- **Start of the clock:** expiry, as shown by the recorded end date of the expired membership in the company's records.
- **Counting:** 60 calendar days counted from that date; the last day of the window is the recorded end date plus 60 calendar days, and that last day is within the window.
- **What reactivation takes:** payment of the fee due; the reactivation fee is 0.00, so nothing further is charged for reactivating.
- **Who carries it out:** reactivation is carried out by the member services representative, and returns the membership from expired to active.
- **On reactivation:** the recorded end date is cleared, and the next renewal date is counted from the reactivation.
- **After the window:** a new membership must be purchased.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Recorded end date of the expired membership | Last day of the reactivation window | Request date | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| June 10 | August 9 | August 9 | Within the window: reactivated on paying the fee due |
| June 10 | August 9 | August 10 | After the window: a new membership must be purchased |

## Hypothetical timeline

A monthly charge fails on a hypothetical October 3 and is retried for 15 calendar days through October 18. It remains unpaid, so the membership expires at the end of its last paid period, and the reactivation window of 60 calendar days counts from the recorded end date.
